name: Shiro no Monogatari
source:
Yasha is a very brutal character. One day he steals some relic and triggers space distortion resulting in the human world. 

The heroine was dying of a heart disease at this time the the jewel that Yasha dropped healed her completely. He tries to take the jewel back, but the girl gets to die in that case. She manages to persuade him to wait for a week and live together for that time. However, it turns out that jewel is not just a precious item, but a "jewel of bliss" that can fulfill one wish.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
夜叉性情極其殘暴。某天，他偷走一件遺物，引發空間扭曲，意外來到人類世界。

女主角藤堂深雪當時正因心臟病發而命在旦夕，夜叉掉落的寶珠卻讓她徹底痊癒。夜叉想把寶珠取回，可一旦失去它，深雪就會死亡。她成功說服夜叉等待一週，並在此期間與自己共同生活。然而，那顆寶珠並非普通貴重物品，而是能夠實現一個願望的「幸福寶珠」。

[譯自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
